kind: FR-3 site occupancy: the references' registered inputs
forms: docs/SITE_OCCUPANCY_DESIGN.md, Appendix A (A.1 to A.5) and §8.3
conventions: c = n/V with n in fmol, V in pL and c in mM; every node's initial ligand is listed as a concentration, the trace included, and nothing but the populations' routes changes the ligand
a population's accessible sites are S = alpha nu N / N_f fmol; R + B = S, with B0 = initial_occupancy x S
binding: J = m_b (k_on c R - k_off B), c the faced node's; internalisation: I = m_i k_int B, into the owner cell's ligand row, the site returning free
an outward population faces its patch's outside node; an inward population faces its owner's cytosol, and internalisation is declared on outward populations only
site_controls hold their multipliers from each time on (right-continuous); every time is an exact multiple of each dt of the ladder
records are the states at the record times, t = 0 included
the free energies are A.3's: G_node = RT n (ln(n/V) - 1) and G_site = B (dG0 + RT ln(B/S)) + RT R ln(R/S), dG0 = RT ln(K_d/1 mM), with RT = 1e-3 R T pJ/fmol

q1_eps_1e-1.form: binding with internalisation, occupancy pre-formed at its quasi-steady value at c0; the receiving cell is 2 pL

q1_eps_1e-2.form: binding with internalisation, occupancy pre-formed at its quasi-steady value at c0

q1_eps_1e-3.form: binding with internalisation, occupancy pre-formed at its quasi-steady value at c0

q1_fast.form: Q1's eps = 0.1 world with every rate 100 times faster (K_d and K_M unchanged)
q1_fast.note: dt L_B = (k_off + k_int) dt = 0.11 at 1 ms, inside the stage condition

q1_eps_1e-1_alpha_half.form: Q1's eps = 0.1 world with half the sites accessible (eps = 0.05)

q2_large.form: binding to equilibrium in a large node at c = K_d

q2_closed.form: binding in a small closed node: depletion (the Riccati form)

q2_two_populations.form: two cells' populations facing one node

q3_dissociation.form: dissociation into a large node held near zero

q3_binding_multiplier.form: the closed node with the binding multiplier at 1/4 from 1 s to 4 s: k_on and k_off scale together, so the approach slows and the equilibrium does not move

q3_internalisation.form: binding and internalisation in a large node

q4_alpha_1_low.form: accessibility alpha = 1 at c = 1e-05 mM (0.01 K_d) in a large node

q4_alpha_1_high.form: accessibility alpha = 1 at c = 0.1 mM (100 K_d) in a large node

q4_alpha_1_2_low.form: accessibility alpha = 1/2 at c = 1e-05 mM (0.01 K_d) in a large node

q4_alpha_1_2_high.form: accessibility alpha = 1/2 at c = 0.1 mM (100 K_d) in a large node

q4_alpha_1_4_low.form: accessibility alpha = 1/4 at c = 1e-05 mM (0.01 K_d) in a large node

q4_alpha_1_4_high.form: accessibility alpha = 1/4 at c = 0.1 mM (100 K_d) in a large node

q5_passive_preformed.form: a pre-formed occupancy above equilibrium, closed node

q5_washout.form: a washout: internalisation drains the bound pool, the node at trace

q5_class_switch.form: Q1's eps = 0.1 world, internalisation off, on at 5 s, off at 10 s

items: Q5 receiving cell faced by an inward population
q5_inward.form: cell_0 (2 pL) receives internalised ligand and is faced by an inward population

q5_background_threshold.form: a washout into a small node at the trace, trace_mM = 1e-09 (the threshold 1e-6 K_d); the trace's share of the node's content, c_bg V / n, stays near 1e-5

q5_background_lowered.form: a washout into a small node at the trace, trace_mM = 1e-12 (1e3 below it); the trace's share of the node's content, c_bg V / n, stays near 1e-5
